dataset.description: This proposal aims at finding the causality chains underlying different cancer phenotypes. Such causal profile will provide a detailed understanding of cancer aetiology, establishment and progression. Additionally, it will deliver testable mechanistic hypotheses, with molecular candidates for future use as biomarkers for molecular diagnosis, prognosis, and targeted therapy.

dataset.type: RNA-seq gene counts (numeric data) and Clinical data (flat text).

dmp.description: This project tackles the challenge of analyzing extensive multi-OMICs cancer datasets to uncover causal relationships and improve understanding of cancer onset and progression. Using publicly available data from TCGA and GTEx repositories, it will combine advanced causality analysis techniques with traditional machine learning. This approach will identify key molecular factors and their interdependencies, enabling the formulation of testable hypotheses and the potential discovery of new biomarkers and therapeutic targets.
